department: Cellular and Molecular Biology Graduate Program (interdepartmental)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (2026), 11PM CST, for Fall 2027; letters and English test scores must also arrive by then.
deadline.quote: The CMB Program’s application deadline is December 1 at 11PM CST. All application materials, including letters of recommendation, must be received by the December 1 deadline.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and is not used even if submitted; do not send scores.
gre_general.quote: CMB no longer requires GRE scores, nor will the Admissions Committee use any GRE scores submitted as part of its review.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; you do three lab rotations before choosing an advisor.
supervisor.quote: Admitted students complete three laboratory rotations in labs of CMB faculty trainers before choosing a faculty advisor.

funding.value: All CMB students are guaranteed a stipend and tuition remission for their whole PhD with satisfactory progress; internationals use a program funding letter instead of bank proof.
funding.quote: Provided that they make satisfactory progress towards their PhD, all CMB students are guaranteed a competitive stipend and tuition remission for the duration of their graduate studies.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's (or comparable international degree) and prior lab research experience.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited US institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution

fee_waiver.value: CMB gives no fee waivers; only Graduate School fee grants (US citizens/permanent residents) apply.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, CMB is not able to provide fee waivers.

notes: Umbrella program; focus groups include cancer biology, immunology, physiology, developmental biology and regenerative medicine, so it is also listed under biomedical sciences.
name: Cellular and Molecular Biology PhD
